title: 第11章 守规矩第12章 他只是一个被牵连的小喽啰
content_zh:
进了天牢就要守着天牢的规矩。
不守规矩，天牢的狱卒会让犯人们知道什么叫做生不如死，什么叫做悔不当初。不需要动刑，有的是办法让犯人就范。敢不给钱，就让你尝尝什么叫人间地狱。
有钱的赶紧爽快给钱，没钱的就想办法找钱。
不将犯人榨出银子来，就是狱卒的失职。
为何一个新丁，每个月都能拿八两十两的奖金，还有其他外快。钱不可能从天上掉下来，天牢关押的犯人，就是天牢衙门上上下下的财源，是大家的收入保证。
所以，除非必要，狱卒也不希望大牢里关押的犯人死掉。
短短几天时间，空空先生终于妥协，吃上了烧鸡，喝上了小酒，就连腿上的伤也进行了治疗包扎。
隔壁的采花贼，比空空先生更识趣，知道自己犯的事遭人恨，从进来第一天就果断配合狱卒的要求，要钱给钱，要料给料，早早过上了喝酒吃肉的日子。
只是，天牢要价太高。
豪客如空空先生也感觉吃不消。
他和陈观楼唠叨，“一天两顿，一顿三十两银子，一天就是六十两。十天就要六百两，百天就是六千两。我如果要换药，还要另外给钱。特么的，这和抢钱有什么区别。我挣点钱容易嘛。”
陈观楼和他熟悉后，也乐意跟他闲聊几句，“说的都是废话，你可以选择不吃。”
“妈的，但凡你们天牢的吃食没那么恶心人，我也就忍了。”
“有的吃就不错了。”
“小哥，要不你帮帮我吧。我知道你收费比别人便宜。反正都是给钱，与其让那帮黑心烂肠子的玩意赚，不如让你赚。”
陈观楼自从得了罗敬天的包裹，如今大小也是个有钱人。他哼了一声，“你看我像是要钱的人吗？”
凡是关进天牢的人，欲望都降到了最低，只求生存。若是有钱，就求生存条件稍微好点，吃点好吃的。如果有钱还有关系，要求就会稍微多一点，除了吃的，还盼着早点了结官司能从天牢活着出去。
活着，活得好一点，就是天牢犯人的诉求。为了这个，大部分犯人都愿意付出性命之外的任何东西，包括不限于老婆孩子爹娘。
“小哥，你别嫌少啊！你想要什么，尽管开口。我只求一口吃的。”空空先生可怜巴巴。
陈观楼似笑非笑，“你确定？我要功法，我要你的独门秘籍，你愿意吗？”

空空先生的表情透着意外，迟疑了片刻之后，他才小心翼翼的，生怕得罪人，语气特别郑重又有些好奇的问道：“你没有武脉……”
“有没有武脉是我的事。你就说愿不愿意吧。”
空空先生显得很纠结犹豫。
陈观楼也不逼他，这本就是一场交易，“你自己考虑。我厚道提醒一句，就算我能帮你，也很有限。你大可将我的话当做玩笑。”
说罢，他继续巡视天牢。
过了两日，空空先生似乎是想通了，再次叫住陈观楼。
“我愿意交易。给了秘籍，就不用给钱？”
“你宁愿舍弃秘籍，都不愿意给钱？”陈观楼还挺意外，都说习武之人将秘籍看得格外重要，为了秘籍杀人夺宝的事情更是经常发生。
空空先生苦笑不已，他也是有苦难言，走投无路啊！否则，他也舍不得拿秘籍换吃的，更是想趁机换一份保障。
他愤恨道：“我也不怕被你们报复，直说吧，那帮狱卒恨不得榨干了我，还要连皮带骨的拆卸。就算我有金山银山也遭不住他们的盘剥。更何况我并没有金山银山。
我也不瞒你，别看我作案多起，好似搞了很多钱，但是像我这样的人，通常钱来的快去得也快，根本没什么积蓄。否则，我也不会心疼银子。
怕就怕，银子被榨干了，那帮狱卒老油条到时候会要我的命。我想活着出去，还不如走走你的路子。陈小哥，你是厚道人，你肯定不会像他们那样。”
“可我只是一个新丁。”
content_en:
When entering the prison, you must abide by the rules of the prison.
If they don't abide by the rules, the jailers will let the prisoners know what it means to live worse than death and what it means to regret. There is no need to use punishment, there are many ways to make the prisoner submit. If you dare not give me money, I will let you taste what hell is on earth.
Those who have money quickly give money, and those who don’t have money find ways to find money.
Not squeezing money out of prisoners would be a dereliction of duty on the part of the jailer.
Why is it that a newbie can get a bonus of eighty taels every month, as well as other extra money. Money cannot fall from the sky. The prisoners detained in Tianlao are the financial resources of Tianlao Yamen and the guarantee of everyone's income.
Therefore, the jailer does not want the prisoners in the prison to die unless necessary.
In just a few days, Mr. Kongkong finally compromised, ate roast chicken, drank some wine, and even had his leg injuries treated and bandaged.
The flower-picking thief next door was more sensible than Mr. Kongkong. He knew that what he had committed was hated by others, so he decisively cooperated with the jailer's requirements from the first day he came in. He asked for money and materials, and he had already lived a life of drinking and eating meat.
However, the price charged for Tianlao is too high.
High rollers such as Mr. Kongkong also feel overwhelmed.
He chatted with Chen Guanlou, "Two meals a day, one meal costs thirty taels of silver, which is sixty taels a day. Ten days is six hundred taels, and a hundred days is six thousand taels. If I want to change the medicine, I have to pay extra. Damn, what's the difference between this and robbing money? It's easy for me to make some money."
After Chen Guanlou got to know him well, he was willing to chat with him, "What he said is all nonsense. You can choose not to eat it."
"Damn, as long as the food you eat in Tianlao is not so disgusting, I will tolerate it."
"It would be nice to eat some."
"Brother, why don't you help me? I know that your charges are cheaper than others. It's all about giving money anyway. Instead of letting those evil-hearted people earn, it's better for you to earn."
Since Chen Guanlou received Luo Jingtian's package, he is now a wealthy man. He snorted, "Do you think I'm someone who wants money?"
Everyone who is imprisoned in the sky prison has their desires reduced to the lowest level and just wants to survive. If you have money, seek better living conditions and some delicious food. If you have money and connections, your requirements will be a little more. In addition to food, you also hope that the lawsuit will be settled early and you can escape from the prison alive.
Live and live better is what the prisoners in Tianjian Prison want. For this, most prisoners are willing to pay anything except their lives, including but not limited to their wives, children, and parents.
"Brother, don't be too little! If you want anything, just ask. I just want a bite." Mr. Kongkong was pitiful.
Chen Guanlou half-smiled, "Are you sure? I want the exercises, I want your unique secret book, are you willing?"
Mr. Kongkong's expression showed surprise. After hesitating for a moment, he cautiously asked in a very solemn and curious tone for fear of offending others: "You have no martial arts..."
"Whether you have martial arts or not is my business. Just say whether you want it or not."
Mr. Kongkong seemed very hesitant.
Chen Guanlou didn't force him, this was just a deal, "You think about it yourself. Let me kindly remind you that even if I can help you, it is very limited. You can take my words as a joke."
After that, he continued to inspect the prison.
Two days later, Mr. Kongkong seemed to have figured it out and stopped Chen Guanlou again.
"I'm willing to trade. If you give me the secret book, you don't have to pay me?"
"You would rather give up the secret book than give money?" Chen Guanlou was quite surprised. It is said that martial arts practitioners regard the secret book as extremely important, and killing people to seize treasures for the secret book often happens.
Mr. Kongkong smiled bitterly. He was also in trouble and had no other choice! Otherwise, he would not be willing to exchange the secret book for food, and would even like to take the opportunity to exchange for a guarantee.
He said angrily: "I'm not afraid of your revenge. To put it bluntly, those jailers wanted to squeeze me dry and dismantle me to the bone.Even if I have gold and silver, I can't withstand their exploitation. What's more, I don't have a mountain of gold or silver.
I won’t hide it from you. Although I have committed many crimes, I seem to have made a lot of money. But for people like me, money usually comes and goes quickly, and I have no savings at all. Otherwise, I wouldn’t feel bad about the silver.
I'm just afraid, my money will be squeezed out, and those old jailers will kill me. If I want to get out alive, I might as well walk your way. Brother Chen, you are a kind person, you will definitely not be like them. "
"But I'm just a newcomer. "
